title: Toddler in Striped Pajamas on Carpeted Stairs, 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming mid-century candid snapshot of a young toddler boy standing on open-riser, plush carpeted stairs behind a slender white metal railing. He is wearing classic striped two-piece pajamas, looking curious and slightly playful as he pauses on the landing in front of a bright window framed by patterned drapery.
